text:
Marc: Quick sync — I'm proposing a short-lived exception to the runtime pinlist for the eu-west region to allow the gptx-2b-q variant for a specific customer canary. Details below.
Anya: What's the trigger? Is this about perf regressions or compatibility?
Marc: It's about latency for an offline customer who's hit unacceptable tail latency on v2.3. We think the quantized variant + small KV-cache tweak will help their shard.
Jordan: Any safety concerns? Model behavior differences we should watch for?
Sasha: We ran the eval harness on the customer's prompt set; quality delta looks within noise but there's a tokenization tweak between runtimes that affects a few templates. I can patch the transforms in a hotfix.
Marc: Proposed window: 2027-03-22 03:00-05:00 UTC (2h). Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Immediate rollback if regression. Approvers?
Anya: I'm +1 if you add a telemetry flag and an alert on hallucination rate + cost delta > 10%.
Jordan: Also add a feature-flagged rollback route and automatic fallback to v2.3 standard runtime if p95 latency > 300ms for 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: runtime-unpin-exception-gptx2b-q by Marc. ID: db-7591. Planned window metadata attached.
ops-bot: Canary monitor started: dashboards pinned: `canary/runtime/gptx2b-q/eu-west`. Alert thresholds: p95 latency 300ms, error rate 0.5%.
Sasha: Pushing a quick patch to prompt templates now — PR: https://git.company/repo/patches/123. Will link to the deploy.
Marc: If ops sees no red flags at 50% for 15m, we'll proceed to 100%. If any alert, immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
Anya: LGTM. I'll be on-call during the window and watching alerts.
Jordan: Noted. I'll draft a short release note: 'temporary runtime pinlist exception for gptx-2b quantized in eu-west — canary-only; rollback triggers and telemetry added.'
Marc: Thanks — I'll kick off the deploy at the start of the window and paste deploy-bot logs here.
deploy-bot: deploy started at 1804326920. canary -> 5%.
deploy-bot: canary progressed to 25% at 1804326980.
ops-bot: Alert: p95 latency crossed 320ms for 3m at 1804327025. Observed spike correlated with a specific customer shard.
Sasha: Initiating rollback for canary now (manual rollback).
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by Sasha.
deploy-bot: rollback complete at 1804327160.
Marc: Postmortem to follow. Immediate action: revert the exception and add additional KV-cache tuning + per-shard routing to avoid this hotspot in future.
